description: This file defines a utility module `NumberUtils` for parsing and serializing various numeric types and bit widths from or into a Uint8Array, with support for endianness detection.

classes.name: NumberUtils
classes.description: A collection of functions that get or set various numeric types and bit widths from a Uint8Array, including endianness detection.

methods.name: isBigEndian
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the current system is big endian.

methods.name: getNonnegativeInt32LE
methods.description: Parses a signed int32 at offset, throws a RangeError if value is negative.

methods.name: getInt32LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from source.

methods.name: getUint32LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from source.

methods.name: getUint32BE
methods.description: Reads a big-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from source.

methods.name: getBigInt64LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 64-bit integer from source, returning a bigint.

methods.name: getFloat64LE
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit float from source, considering system endianness.

methods.name: setInt32BE
methods.description: Writes a big-endian 32-bit signed or unsigned integer to destination.

methods.name: setInt32LE
methods.description: Writes a little-endian 32-bit signed or unsigned integer to destination.

methods.name: setBigInt64LE
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer (bigint) to destination in little-endian.

methods.name: setFloat64LE
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit float to destination considering system endianness.
